regions.today: Some bright or sunny spells but mostly cloudy for the rest of today with patchy hill fog. It will be dry apart from the odd spot of light drizzle. Mild and humid with moderate southwest winds, fresh at times near the south coast.
regions.tonight: Cloudy tonight with patchy drizzle, mist and hill fog. The mist will thicken into fog in some places. Mild with temperatures dipping no lower than 13 to 15 degrees in moderate southwest winds, fresh at times near the south coast.
regions.tomorrow: Mist and fog will clear most parts on Monday morning, but may linger near the south coast into the afternoon. A largely dry day with isolated patches of drizzle. Again, there will be some bright or short sunny spells but a good deal of cloud overall with patchy hill fog. Mild and humid with highest temperatures of 16 to 19 degrees. Moderate west to southwest winds, fresh at times near the south coast, will decrease mostly light later in the day.
